title: Early Prediction of Diabetes Using an Ensemble of Machine Learning Models
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
pdf_fetch_attempts: 2026-07-01: Direct MDPI PDF returned 403; Unpaywall confirmed OA and PMC mirror; downloaded source.pdf via Europe PMC render route https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC9566114?pdf=render; verified %PDF- and ~25 pages.
abstract: Introduces a newly labeled Bangladesh diabetes dataset and an automated early diabetes prediction pipeline using preprocessing, missing-value imputation, RF-based feature selection, grid search, and a weighted ensemble of DT/RF/XGBoost/LightGBM; reports accuracy 0.735 and AUC 0.832.
scope_note: Đúng scope diabetes prediction tabular; mạnh vì public dataset+code GitHub, citation đạt gate, bổ sung early_detection ngoài các dataset quen thuộc.
